title: Shift comparison for internal derived Hom
statement: On a small ringed site (C,O), let D(O) be its unbounded derived category [def-pur-derived-internal-hom]. There is a family e(P,Q,m,n): RHom(P,Q)[n-m] ≅ RHom(P[m],Q[n]) for every P,Q and integers m,n. For q:Q→Qprime, shifted(RHom(id_P,q)) followed by e(P,Qprime,m,n) equals e(P,Q,m,n) followed by RHom(id_(P[m]),q[n]). This is an isomorphism in D(O), before taking global sections or cohomology, with no boundedness or K-flatness hypothesis.

source.place: Sections 21.34 and 21.35, Hom-complex differential and representative computation (Tags 0A8X and 08JA); signed shift calculation in step 2 of lem-sc-global-hom-shifted-hypercohomology

proof.text: Represent P by L and Q by a K-injective I, using functorial K-injective resolutions. The representative comparison identifies RHom(P,Q) with Q(Hom(L,I)). Shifts of I are K-injective by shifting the acyclic test complex in the defining null-homotopy condition.

For integers m,n,k, identify Hom(L,I)[n-m]^k with Hom(L[m],I[n])^k by reindexing r=p+m and multiplying the p-th component by (-1)^(m*k). The two differential formulas differ by (-1)^m; multiplying in consecutive degrees compensates for this factor. Reindexing backwards and applying the same sign is the inverse. Each map is a sheaf-module map and the construction commutes with postcomposition.

Localize the chain isomorphism and transport through the representative comparisons. Maps between K-injective representatives compute derived morphisms; homotopic choices induce equal localized Hom-complex maps. Quasi-isomorphism invariance allows resolution changes, and postcomposition naturality of the signed reindexing yields shifted(RHom(P,q)) followed by e_Qprime = e_Q followed by RHom(P[m],q[n]).

proof_origin.place: Sections 21.34 and 21.35; explicit signed reindexing of the Hom-complex differential

lean.statement:
theorem derivedInternalHom_shift_comparison
    {C : Type u} [SmallCategory C]
    (J : GrothendieckTopology C) (R : Sheaf J CommRingCat.{u})
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u}
      ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj R))] :
    ∃ e : ∀ (P Q : DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{u}
        ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj R))) (m n : ℤ),
      ((derivedInternalHom J R).obj (op P, Q))⟦n - m⟧ ≅
        (derivedInternalHom J R).obj (op (P⟦m⟧), Q⟦n⟧),
      ∀ (P Q Q' : DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{u}
          ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj R)))
        (m n : ℤ) (q : Q ⟶ Q'),
        ((derivedInternalHom J R).map ((𝟙 P).op, q))⟦n - m⟧' ≫
            (e P Q' m n).hom =
          (e P Q m n).hom ≫
            (derivedInternalHom J R).map ((𝟙 (P⟦m⟧)).op, q⟦n⟧')
